answer: Sybil resistance can be bought, not asserted: every new identity is a soulbound opal ticket, minted only at a public auction where existing members set the clearing price and keep the proceeds. A thousand fake agents thus need a thousand auction wins paid to the honest coalition, and the tickets never resell, so the spend is unrecoverable. Each mint is stamped into a marble ledger; bursts sharing one funding source have their weight decayed before counting. The sable discipline is accounting, not sentiment: an attacker burns capital per voice while defenders are paid to keep the gate narrow.
